extraction_warnings: Paper reports cohort-level aggregates (n=41 healthy controls, n=56 pre-hypertensive, n=99 hypertensive) without per-sample individual identifiers, ages, or sex assignments. Samples extracted represent three subgroup categories rather than distinct individual samples.
Individual participant characteristics (age, sex, BMI) are reported only at group level with summary statistics or group comparisons, not per-sample.

Fecal microbiota transplantation donor samples (n=3: 2 HTN, 1 control) were used but donors are not separately extractable as study subjects with individual metadata; recipient mice are excluded as they are not human study participants.
Metabolomic subset (n=124) extracted from the main cohort (n=30 controls, n=31 pHTN, n=63 HTN) but individual sample-level metabolite values are not reported in the paper.
Antibiotics and probiotics exclusion criteria applied: 'Individuals were also excluded if they had received antibiotics or probiotics within the last 8 weeks,' applies to all enrolled participants.
